title: User-Computer Authentication Associations in Time
access_license: Public download; LANL states copyright/related rights waived to extent possible
scale_and_schema: 9 continuous months; 708,304,516 successful events; each row time,user,computer; 11,362 users; 22,284 computers
identity_semantics: authentication event; user-computer association; temporal authentication graph
instantiation_suitability: High for Authentication event, IdentitySubject/Account proxy, Resource/Computer and temporal relation instantiation
evaluation_suitability: High for scale, graph/trace-based CQ evaluation and cross-event consistency
main_risks: Successful events only; anonymized; no explicit credential/session/authorization semantics; must not infer human/legal identity from user IDs

title: Login Data Set for Risk-Based Authentication
scale_and_schema: More than 33M login attempts and 3.3M users; user ID, timestamp, IP/geolocation, ASN, user agent, OS/browser/device type, RTT, success, attack/account-takeover labels
identity_semantics: login attempt; authentication success/failure; account; device/context; risk/attack labels
instantiation_suitability: High for AuthenticationAttempt/AuthResult, Account, Device/ClientContext and risk-context scenario instantiation
evaluation_suitability: High for CQ evaluation involving context, success/failure and risk; manageable sampling possible
main_risks: Feature values are synthetic while preserving selected real distributions/relations; not suitable as production-security ground truth

title: ID4D Global Dataset 2025
scale_and_schema: Country/national-level demand- and supply-side indicators through 2024; foundational-ID ownership/use and digital-ID capability including remote authentication availability
identity_semantics: official-ID coverage; foundational ID; digital credential availability; remote authentication capability; lifecycle/system characteristics
instantiation_suitability: Medium for Government Profile instances and country/system capability examples; not event-level
evaluation_suitability: High for government-profile coverage/context and cross-country capability queries; low for authentication-event testing
main_risks: Aggregate/national indicators; does not expose individual identity transactions; must not be treated as normative ontology source

title: Global Findex Database 2025 world microdata with ID4D module
access_license: World Bank Microdata Library access; verify redistribution/derived-artifact terms before packaging raw data
scale_and_schema: 2024 individual survey microdata covering 140+ economies; includes ID4D questionnaire variables alongside connectivity/financial inclusion modules
identity_semantics: ID ownership/use; digital identity access/use; demographic/context variables
instantiation_suitability: Medium-to-high for person-level government-ID use examples and population-level query demonstrations
evaluation_suitability: Medium-high for validation of coverage/use questions and profile examples; complementary to ID4D supply-side series
main_risks: Survey/self-report semantics; not operational identity events; sampling weights and survey design must be respected; avoid inferring technical assurance from ownership/use answers
recommendation: SECONDARY — optional person-level complement to DATA-003
